notes: MultilinearMap was generalized to multisemilinear maps over a ring hom in Mathlib v4.36.0; MultilinearMap (RingHom.id K) (fun i => A i) M is definitionally equivalent to the old K-linear MultilinearMap K (fun i => A i) M (same underlying map and scalar compatibility). Statement updated solely for this Mathlib signature change; added RingHom.id_apply in proof.
